title: Laser-Cut Box
description: I created a box by designing a 3D model in Autodesk Fusion 360 and laser cutting a pattern from a sheet of cardboard, producing an accurately cut cardboard template that was assembled into a clean box.

timeline.heading: Objective
timeline.description: The objective of this project was to model a box in Fusion 360, laser cut the pattern from a sheet of cardboard, and assemble it into a clean box, gaining more experience with 3D modeling and laser cutting along the way.

timeline.heading: The Design Process
timeline.description: For this project, I designed the box using Autodesk Fusion to gain a deeper understanding of the software. I started with a simple box by extruding a rectangular sketch. Then, I created the long and short walls by creating new sketches and extruding them. Throughout the process, I used tools I hadn't used before, like constraints, construction lines, and the mirror tool, to create the walls. After I finished, I verified that the dimensions of the box were correct and exported the project as a PDF for the laser cutter.

timeline.heading: Cutting
timeline.description: I uploaded the PDF I exported to the laser cutter and configured the settings of the cutter. After that, I placed the cardboard sheet in the cutter and started the cutter, running it a few times through to ensure the cutter cut through the sheet. After it was doone, I took out the cardboard and separated the box pieces from the sheet.

resources.caption: Laser Cutter Machine Fufilling its Sole Purpose

timeline.heading: Final Product
timeline.description:
I took all the pieces and assembled them to form a box. Overall, the box fit well and held together well on its own. After cutting, I noticed that the laser cutter didn't fully cut through the sheet. Also, there was a lot of ash and burn marks on the edges of the box.

Next time, I could increase the frequency of the laser cutter from 500 to 2000 to decrease the time spent cutting and get a deeper cut. I learned a lot more about Fusion in this project, like constraint and mirroring tools to draw sketches, as well as how to use the laser cutters. I think this knowledge could be useful when I need to cut material into a 3D structure in a future project.
